audit.why: EVEN / 6/10 with an 8.5/10 carry threat fits 55.94% over 774 games: an honest ranged scrap at 1-2, Quinn ahead from 3 through first item, Lucian the hypercarry at two-plus items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 read Quinn while its why says 'he can still trade back with double-shot, so it stays skill-matched', and Levels 4-5 and Level 6 read Skill while their whys say you convert the level-3 edge into plates and that R gives you roam tempo his combat-only ult cannot answer.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill, Skill, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, and the audited mirror moved exactly these three rows.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Skill, rows 3 and 4 to Quinn, in matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Relentless Pursuit is treated as a fixed cooldown to count down, but Lightslinger attacks reduce it — so the clock is wrong every time he lands autos. No range or cooldown numbers appear anywhere.
audit.why: Kit: E 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, and 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown'. Q is 500 range on 9s at rank 1; R is 110s at 1400 range. The blind advice is correct here and was left intact — Lightslinger is a basic-attack effect, so Blinding Assault does shut it off.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and report[5].t now carry the real numbers and the reduction mechanic, so the reader counts his autos rather than the clock.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Engage when it's down' with no duration and no mention that the duration shrinks.
audit.why: 16s at rank 1 falling to 14s, further reduced by every Lightslinger double-shot.
audit.corrected: Written into the cooldown block, the do's and report[5].

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: 16s at rank 1, but Lightslinger attacks cut it — engage when it is spent. - Piercing Light: 9s at rank 1 and only 500 range. - The Culling: 110s and reaches 1400.

edits.before: Lucian wastes Relentless Pursuit — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit spent — you have 16 seconds to run the pattern.

edits.before: Track Lucian's Relentless Pursuit: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Blind + vault re-kite.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 and Lightslinger attacks shorten it — count his autos, not the clock.

notes: Deliberately did NOT act on two missing-interaction rows built on lucian.json's passive flags. Lightslinger is tagged heal and hardCC, which produced a 'needs-antiheal' row and a 'Lucian can cancel your Behind Enemy Lines with Lightslinger' row — but Riot's text says the passive triggers WHEN LUCIAN IS healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy is immobilized. It is not a heal he applies and not CC he applies, so neither claim would be true. Also avoided any statement about whether the blind stops The Culling: the kit does not say, and I am not guessing. Per the mirror, focus.text is 24 characters and the applier skips strings under 25, so the wrong 'Dash/Blind' label there cannot be fixed by a normal edit and needs the focus string regenerated.
